source_records.text: In the third year of King Joakim of Judea, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon arrived at Jerusalem and besieged it.
source_records.display_text: In the third year of King Joakim of Judea, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon arrived at Jerusalem and besieged it.

source_records.text: The Lord handed the city into his hands, together with Joakim king of Judea and a portion of the Lord’s sacred vessels. He carried them away to Babylon and deposited them in his idol-temple.
source_records.display_text: The Lord handed the city into his hands, together with Joakim king of Judea and a portion of the Lord’s sacred vessels. He carried them away to Babylon and deposited them in his idol-temple.

source_records.text: The king told Abiesdri, his chief eunuch, to bring him some of the sons of Israel’s magnates, of the royal family and of the chosen men:
source_records.display_text: The king told Abiesdri, his chief eunuch, to bring him some of the sons of Israel’s magnates, of the royal family and of the chosen men:

source_records.text: young men without blemish, handsome, knowledgeable in every kind of wisdom, literate, intelligent, wise, and strong enough to be in the king’s house, and to teach them letters and the Chaldean tongue,
source_records.display_text: young men without blemish, handsome, knowledgeable in every kind of wisdom, literate, intelligent, wise, and strong enough to be in the king’s house, and to teach them letters and the Chaldean tongue,

source_records.text: and to give them a ration from the king’s house each day, from the royal table and the wine the king drank, and to educate them for three years and place some of them before the king.
source_records.display_text: and to give them a ration from the king’s house each day, from the royal table and the wine the king drank, and to educate them for three years and place some of them before the king.

source_records.text: Among the lineage of Israel’s sons from Judea were Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah.
source_records.display_text: Among the lineage of Israel’s sons from Judea were Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah.

source_records.text: The chief eunuch assigned them names: Daniel, Baltasar; Hananiah, Sedrach; Mishael, Misach; and Azariah, Abdenago.
source_records.display_text: The chief eunuch assigned them names: Daniel, Baltasar; Hananiah, Sedrach; Mishael, Misach; and Azariah, Abdenago.

source_records.text: Daniel considered in his heart how he might avoid being polluted by the king’s dinner and the wine he drank, and petitioned the chief eunuch that he might not be contaminated.
source_records.display_text: Daniel considered in his heart how he might avoid being polluted by the king’s dinner and the wine he drank, and petitioned the chief eunuch that he might not be contaminated.

source_records.text: The Lord gave Daniel honor and favor before the chief eunuch.
source_records.display_text: The Lord gave Daniel honor and favor before the chief eunuch.

source_records.text: The chief eunuch said to Daniel, “I am anxious about my lord the king, who prescribed your food and drink, lest he see your faces drawn and weak beside the foreign youths being reared with you, and I risk my own neck.”
source_records.display_text: The chief eunuch said to Daniel, “I am anxious about my lord the king, who prescribed your food and drink, lest he see your faces drawn and weak beside the foreign youths being reared with you, and I risk my own neck.”

source_records.text: Daniel said to Abiesdri, appointed chief eunuch over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah,
source_records.display_text: Daniel said to Abiesdri, appointed chief eunuch over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah,

source_records.text: “Test your servants for ten days, and let us be given legumes from the earth to eat, and water to drink.
source_records.display_text: “Test your servants for ten days, and let us be given legumes from the earth to eat, and water to drink.

source_records.text: If our appearance looks drawn beside the other young men eating the royal dinner, then deal with your servants however you wish.”
source_records.display_text: If our appearance looks drawn beside the other young men eating the royal dinner, then deal with your servants however you wish.”

source_records.text: He dealt with them in this manner and tested them for ten days.
source_records.display_text: He dealt with them in this manner and tested them for ten days.

source_records.text: After ten days their appearance was good and their bodily condition better than the other young men eating the royal dinner.
source_records.display_text: After ten days their appearance was good and their bodily condition better than the other young men eating the royal dinner.

source_records.text: Abiesdri kept removing their dinner and wine and giving them legumes in exchange.
source_records.display_text: Abiesdri kept removing their dinner and wine and giving them legumes in exchange.

source_records.text: The Lord gave the young men knowledge, understanding, and practical wisdom in every literary skill; to Daniel He gave understanding in every utterance, vision, dreams, and all wisdom.
source_records.display_text: The Lord gave the young men knowledge, understanding, and practical wisdom in every literary skill; to Daniel He gave understanding in every utterance, vision, dreams, and all wisdom.

source_records.text: After these days the king ordered them brought in, and the chief eunuch brought them before King Nebuchadnezzar.
source_records.display_text: After these days the king ordered them brought in, and the chief eunuch brought them before King Nebuchadnezzar.

source_records.text: The king conversed with them, and among the wise no one was found like Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah. They remained beside the king.
source_records.display_text: The king conversed with them, and among the wise no one was found like Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah. They remained beside the king.

source_records.text: In every matter of discourse, understanding, and education about which the king questioned them, he found them ten times wiser than the learned experts and philosophers throughout his kingdom. The king honored them, appointed them rulers, and declared them wiser than all his own men in affairs throughout his land and kingdom.
source_records.display_text: In every matter of discourse, understanding, and education about which the king questioned them, he found them ten times wiser than the learned experts and philosophers throughout his kingdom. The king honored them, appointed them rulers, and declared them wiser than all his own men in affairs throughout his land and kingdom.

source_records.text: Daniel remained until the first year of the reign of Cyrus king of the Persians.
source_records.display_text: Daniel remained until the first year of the reign of Cyrus king of the Persians.

source_records.text: In the second year of Nebuchadnezzar’s reign, the king fell into visions and dreams and was disturbed in his dream, and his sleep left him.
source_records.display_text: In the second year of Nebuchadnezzar’s reign, the king fell into visions and dreams and was disturbed in his dream, and his sleep left him.

source_records.text: The king ordered the incantation-singers, magi, and sorcerers of the Chaldeans brought in to report his dreams to him. They arrived and stood beside the king.
source_records.display_text: The king ordered the incantation-singers, magi, and sorcerers of the Chaldeans brought in to report his dreams to him. They arrived and stood beside the king.

source_records.text: The king said to them, “I have seen a dream, and my spirit was stirred; therefore I wish to understand the dream.”
source_records.display_text: The king said to them, “I have seen a dream, and my spirit was stirred; therefore I wish to understand the dream.”

source_records.text: The Chaldeans spoke to the king in the Syrian language: “My lord king, live for ever! Report your dream to your servants, and we will explain its interpretation to you.”
source_records.display_text: The Chaldeans spoke to the king in the Syrian language: “My lord king, live for ever! Report your dream to your servants, and we will explain its interpretation to you.”

source_records.text: The king answered the Chaldeans, “Unless you truthfully report the dream to me and disclose its interpretation, you will be made a public example, and your possessions will be taken into the royal treasury.
source_records.display_text: The king answered the Chaldeans, “Unless you truthfully report the dream to me and disclose its interpretation, you will be made a public example, and your possessions will be taken into the royal treasury.

source_records.text: But if you make the dream clear to me and report its interpretation, you will receive gifts of every kind and be honored by me. Disclose the dream to me and interpret it.”
source_records.display_text: But if you make the dream clear to me and report its interpretation, you will receive gifts of every kind and be honored by me. Disclose the dream to me and interpret it.”

source_records.text: They answered a second time, “O king, state the vision, and your servants will interpret accordingly.”
source_records.display_text: They answered a second time, “O king, state the vision, and your servants will interpret accordingly.”

source_records.text: The king said to them, “I know for certain that you are buying time, since you have seen that the matter has departed from me. As I have commanded, so it will be.
source_records.display_text: The king said to them, “I know for certain that you are buying time, since you have seen that the matter has departed from me. As I have commanded, so it will be.

source_records.text: Unless you truthfully report the dream and disclose its interpretation, you will meet death. You have agreed together to speak false words before me until the time changes. Now, if you tell me what I saw during the night, I will know that you can also disclose its interpretation.”
source_records.display_text: Unless you truthfully report the dream and disclose its interpretation, you will meet death. You have agreed together to speak false words before me until the time changes. Now, if you tell me what I saw during the night, I will know that you can also disclose its interpretation.”

source_records.text: The Chaldeans answered before the king, “No one on earth can tell the king what he has seen, as you ask. No king and no ruler asks such a thing of any wise man, magus, or Chaldean.
source_records.display_text: The Chaldeans answered before the king, “No one on earth can tell the king what he has seen, as you ask. No king and no ruler asks such a thing of any wise man, magus, or Chaldean.

source_records.text: The matter you seek, O king, is weighty and extraordinary. No one can disclose these things to the king except perhaps an angel, whose dwelling is not with any flesh. Therefore it cannot happen as you suppose.”
source_records.display_text: The matter you seek, O king, is weighty and extraordinary. No one can disclose these things to the king except perhaps an angel, whose dwelling is not with any flesh. Therefore it cannot happen as you suppose.”

source_records.text: Then the king became gloomy and deeply grieved and ordered all the wise men of Babylonia brought out.
source_records.display_text: Then the king became gloomy and deeply grieved and ordered all the wise men of Babylonia brought out.

source_records.text: It was decreed that all should be killed, and Daniel and everyone with him were sought so that they might perish together.
source_records.display_text: It was decreed that all should be killed, and Daniel and everyone with him were sought so that they might perish together.

source_records.text: Then Daniel shared his counsel and judgment with Arioch, the king’s chief cook, who had been ordered to bring out Babylonia’s learned men,
source_records.display_text: Then Daniel shared his counsel and judgment with Arioch, the king’s chief cook, who had been ordered to bring out Babylonia’s learned men,

source_records.text: and questioned him, saying, “On what matter is such a bitter decree being issued by the king?” Then Arioch explained the command to Daniel.
source_records.display_text: and questioned him, saying, “On what matter is such a bitter decree being issued by the king?” Then Arioch explained the command to Daniel.

source_records.text: Daniel quickly went in to the king and petitioned for time from the king, so that he might disclose everything before him.
source_records.display_text: Daniel quickly went in to the king and petitioned for time from the king, so that he might disclose everything before him.

source_records.text: Then Daniel went to his house and explained everything to his companions Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah.
source_records.display_text: Then Daniel went to his house and explained everything to his companions Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah.

source_records.text: He called for fasting and supplication and for help to be sought from the Lord Most High concerning this mystery, so that Daniel and those with him would not be handed over to destruction with Babylon’s learned men.
source_records.display_text: He called for fasting and supplication and for help to be sought from the Lord Most High concerning this mystery, so that Daniel and those with him would not be handed over to destruction with Babylon’s learned men.

source_records.text: Then, in a vision that very night, the king’s mystery was plainly revealed to Daniel. Daniel blessed the Lord Most High,
source_records.display_text: Then, in a vision that very night, the king’s mystery was plainly revealed to Daniel. Daniel blessed the Lord Most High,

source_records.text: and cried out, “The name of the great Lord will be blessed for ever, because wisdom and majesty belong to Him.
source_records.display_text: and cried out, “The name of the great Lord will be blessed for ever, because wisdom and majesty belong to Him.

source_records.text: He changes seasons and times, transfers kings and appoints them, gives wisdom to the wise and understanding to those who possess knowledge,
source_records.display_text: He changes seasons and times, transfers kings and appoints them, gives wisdom to the wise and understanding to those who possess knowledge,

source_records.text: reveals deep and dark things, knows what is in darkness and what is in light, and with Him is a dwelling.
source_records.display_text: reveals deep and dark things, knows what is in darkness and what is in light, and with Him is a dwelling.

source_records.text: To Thee, Lord of my fathers, I give thanks and praise, because Thou hast given me wisdom and prudence. Now Thou hast shown me everything I requested, to disclose these things to the king.”
source_records.display_text: To Thee, Lord of my fathers, I give thanks and praise, because Thou hast given me wisdom and prudence. Now Thou hast shown me everything I requested, to disclose these things to the king.”

source_records.text: Daniel went to Arioch, whom the king had appointed to kill all Babylonia’s learned men, and said, “Do not destroy Babylonia’s learned men. Bring me to the king, and I will disclose every detail to him.”
source_records.display_text: Daniel went to Arioch, whom the king had appointed to kill all Babylonia’s learned men, and said, “Do not destroy Babylonia’s learned men. Bring me to the king, and I will disclose every detail to him.”

source_records.text: Then Arioch urgently brought Daniel to the king and said, “I have found a wise man from the captivity of the sons of Judea who will disclose every detail to the king.”
source_records.display_text: Then Arioch urgently brought Daniel to the king and said, “I have found a wise man from the captivity of the sons of Judea who will disclose every detail to the king.”

source_records.text: The king answered Daniel, who was called Baltasar in Chaldean, “Will you be able to disclose to me the vision I saw and its interpretation?”
source_records.display_text: The king answered Daniel, who was called Baltasar in Chaldean, “Will you be able to disclose to me the vision I saw and its interpretation?”

source_records.text: Daniel spoke aloud before the king, “Disclosure of the mystery the king saw does not belong to wise men, sorcerers, incantation-singers, or gazarenes,
source_records.display_text: Daniel spoke aloud before the king, “Disclosure of the mystery the king saw does not belong to wise men, sorcerers, incantation-singers, or gazarenes,

source_records.text: but there is a God in heaven who uncovers mysteries, who has disclosed to King Nebuchadnezzar what must happen in the last days. O king, live for ever! This is the dream and the vision of your head upon your bed:
source_records.display_text: but there is a God in heaven who uncovers mysteries, who has disclosed to King Nebuchadnezzar what must happen in the last days. O king, live for ever! This is the dream and the vision of your head upon your bed:

source_records.text: You, O king, reclining upon your bed, saw everything that must happen in the last days, and the Revealer of mysteries disclosed to you what must happen.
source_records.display_text: You, O king, reclining upon your bed, saw everything that must happen in the last days, and the Revealer of mysteries disclosed to you what must happen.

source_records.text: This mystery was revealed to me because of no wisdom in me beyond all people; rather, so that it might be disclosed to the king, what you conceived in your heart was made known to me.
source_records.display_text: This mystery was revealed to me because of no wisdom in me beyond all people; rather, so that it might be disclosed to the king, what you conceived in your heart was made known to me.

source_records.text: You, O king, saw a single image. That image was exceedingly large, its appearance was extraordinary as it stood before you, and the image’s appearance was frightening.
source_records.display_text: You, O king, saw a single image. That image was exceedingly large, its appearance was extraordinary as it stood before you, and the image’s appearance was frightening.

source_records.text: Its head was good gold, its chest and arms silver, and its belly and thighs bronze,
source_records.display_text: Its head was good gold, its chest and arms silver, and its belly and thighs bronze,

source_records.text: its legs iron, and its feet partly iron and partly earthenware.
source_records.display_text: its legs iron, and its feet partly iron and partly earthenware.

source_records.text: You watched until a stone was cut from a mountain without hands. It struck the image on its feet of iron and earthenware and ground them down.
source_records.display_text: You watched until a stone was cut from a mountain without hands. It struck the image on its feet of iron and earthenware and ground them down.

source_records.text: Then the iron, earthenware, bronze, silver, and gold were ground fine together, becoming finer than chaff on a threshing floor. The wind scattered them so that nothing remained of them. The stone that struck the image became a great mountain and struck the whole earth.
source_records.display_text: Then the iron, earthenware, bronze, silver, and gold were ground fine together, becoming finer than chaff on a threshing floor. The wind scattered them so that nothing remained of them. The stone that struck the image became a great mountain and struck the whole earth.

source_records.text: This was the vision; now we will state its interpretation before the king.
source_records.display_text: This was the vision; now we will state its interpretation before the king.

source_records.text: You, O king, are king of kings, and the Lord of heaven has given you rule, kingdom, strength, honor, and glory.
source_records.display_text: You, O king, are king of kings, and the Lord of heaven has given you rule, kingdom, strength, honor, and glory.

source_records.text: Throughout the inhabited world He has handed over into your hands human beings, wild beasts, birds of heaven, and fish of the sea, to rule them all. You are the golden head.
source_records.display_text: Throughout the inhabited world He has handed over into your hands human beings, wild beasts, birds of heaven, and fish of the sea, to rule them all. You are the golden head.

source_records.text: After you a kingdom lesser than you will arise, and another, a third kingdom of bronze, which will rule the whole earth.
source_records.display_text: After you a kingdom lesser than you will arise, and another, a third kingdom of bronze, which will rule the whole earth.

source_records.text: A fourth kingdom will be strong like iron that subdues everything and cuts down every tree, and the whole earth will be shaken.
source_records.display_text: A fourth kingdom will be strong like iron that subdues everything and cuts down every tree, and the whole earth will be shaken.

source_records.text: As you saw its feet partly potter’s earthenware and partly iron, another kingdom, divided in two, will be within it, just as you saw iron mixed with clay earthenware.
source_records.display_text: As you saw its feet partly potter’s earthenware and partly iron, another kingdom, divided in two, will be within it, just as you saw iron mixed with clay earthenware.

source_records.text: The toes of the feet were partly iron and partly earthenware; part of the kingdom will be strong and part shattered.
source_records.display_text: The toes of the feet were partly iron and partly earthenware; part of the kingdom will be strong and part shattered.

source_records.text: As you saw iron mixed with clay earthenware, they will be mingled in human generation, but will neither agree nor have goodwill toward one another, just as iron cannot blend with earthenware.
source_records.display_text: As you saw iron mixed with clay earthenware, they will be mingled in human generation, but will neither agree nor have goodwill toward one another, just as iron cannot blend with earthenware.

source_records.text: In the times of these kings the God of heaven will establish another kingdom, which will exist for ever and will not be destroyed. This kingdom will not leave another nation; it will strike and obliterate these kingdoms and will itself stand for ever,

source_records.text: just as you saw a stone cut from a mountain without hands, pounding together the earthenware, iron, bronze, silver, and gold. The great God has shown the king what will happen in the last days. The vision is exact, and its interpretation trustworthy.”
source_records.display_text: just as you saw a stone cut from a mountain without hands, pounding together the earthenware, iron, bronze, silver, and gold. The great God has shown the king what will happen in the last days. The vision is exact, and its interpretation trustworthy.”

source_records.text: Then King Nebuchadnezzar fell face down on the ground and prostrated himself before Daniel. He ordered sacrifices and libations made to him.
source_records.display_text: Then King Nebuchadnezzar fell face down on the ground and prostrated himself before Daniel. He ordered sacrifices and libations made to him.

source_records.text: The king spoke aloud to Daniel, “Truly your God is God of gods and Lord of kings, the One who alone brings hidden mysteries to light, because you have been able to disclose this mystery.”
source_records.display_text: The king spoke aloud to Daniel, “Truly your God is God of gods and Lord of kings, the One who alone brings hidden mysteries to light, because you have been able to disclose this mystery.”

source_records.text: Then King Nebuchadnezzar exalted Daniel, gave him many great gifts, placed him over Babylonia’s affairs, and appointed him ruler and leader of all Babylonia’s learned men.
source_records.display_text: Then King Nebuchadnezzar exalted Daniel, gave him many great gifts, placed him over Babylonia’s affairs, and appointed him ruler and leader of all Babylonia’s learned men.

source_records.text: Daniel petitioned the king that Sedrach, Misach, and Abdenago be appointed over Babylonia’s affairs. Daniel remained in the royal court.
source_records.display_text: Daniel petitioned the king that Sedrach, Misach, and Abdenago be appointed over Babylonia’s affairs. Daniel remained in the royal court.

source_records.text: In the eighteenth year, King Nebuchadnezzar, who administered cities and countries and all who inhabited the earth from India to Ethiopia, made a golden image, sixty cubits high and six cubits wide. He set it up on the plain of the enclosure in the country of Babylonia.
source_records.display_text: In the eighteenth year, King Nebuchadnezzar, who administered cities and countries and all who inhabited the earth from India to Ethiopia, made a golden image, sixty cubits high and six cubits wide. He set it up on the plain of the enclosure in the country of Babylonia.

source_records.text: Nebuchadnezzar, king of kings and lord of the whole inhabited world, sent to gather all the nations, tribes, and languages, satraps, generals, district governors, consuls, administrators, those holding authority in each country, and everyone throughout the inhabited world, to come to the dedication of the golden image that King Nebuchadnezzar had set up.
source_records.display_text: Nebuchadnezzar, king of kings and lord of the whole inhabited world, sent to gather all the nations, tribes, and languages, satraps, generals, district governors, consuls, administrators, those holding authority in each country, and everyone throughout the inhabited world, to come to the dedication of the golden image that King Nebuchadnezzar had set up.

source_records.text: Those previously listed stood opposite the image.
source_records.display_text: Those previously listed stood opposite the image.

source_records.text: The herald proclaimed to the crowds, “You are commanded, nations and countries, peoples and languages:
source_records.display_text: The herald proclaimed to the crowds, “You are commanded, nations and countries, peoples and languages:

source_records.text: when you hear the sound of trumpet, panpipe, kithara, sambuca, psaltery, symphonia, and every kind of musical instrument, fall down and bow to the golden image that King Nebuchadnezzar has set up.
source_records.display_text: when you hear the sound of trumpet, panpipe, kithara, sambuca, psaltery, symphonia, and every kind of musical instrument, fall down and bow to the golden image that King Nebuchadnezzar has set up.

source_records.text: They will throw into the blazing furnace anyone who does not fall down and bow.”
source_records.display_text: They will throw into the blazing furnace anyone who does not fall down and bow.”

source_records.text: At that time, when all the nations heard the sound of the trumpet and every musical sound, all the nations, tribes, and languages fell down and bowed to the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar had set up before him.
source_records.display_text: At that time, when all the nations heard the sound of the trumpet and every musical sound, all the nations, tribes, and languages fell down and bowed to the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar had set up before him.

source_records.text: At that time Chaldean men came forward and accused the Jews.
source_records.display_text: At that time Chaldean men came forward and accused the Jews.

source_records.text: They spoke and said, “My lord king, live for ever!
source_records.display_text: They spoke and said, “My lord king, live for ever!

source_records.text: You, O king, commanded and decreed that everyone who hears the trumpet and every musical sound must fall down and bow to the golden image.
source_records.display_text: You, O king, commanded and decreed that everyone who hears the trumpet and every musical sound must fall down and bow to the golden image.

source_records.text: Whoever does not fall down and bow will be thrown into the blazing furnace.
source_records.display_text: Whoever does not fall down and bow will be thrown into the blazing furnace.

source_records.text: There are certain Jewish men whom you appointed over the country of Babylonia—Sedrach, Misach, and Abdenago. Those men have not feared your command; they have not served your idol or bowed to your golden image that you set up.”
source_records.display_text: There are certain Jewish men whom you appointed over the country of Babylonia—Sedrach, Misach, and Abdenago. Those men have not feared your command; they have not served your idol or bowed to your golden image that you set up.”

source_records.text: Then Nebuchadnezzar, angered with wrath, ordered Sedrach, Misach, and Abdenago brought in. The men were brought to the king.
source_records.display_text: Then Nebuchadnezzar, angered with wrath, ordered Sedrach, Misach, and Abdenago brought in. The men were brought to the king.

source_records.text: When King Nebuchadnezzar saw them, he said to them, “Why, Sedrach, Misach, and Abdenago, do you not serve my gods or bow to the golden image I set up?
source_records.display_text: When King Nebuchadnezzar saw them, he said to them, “Why, Sedrach, Misach, and Abdenago, do you not serve my gods or bow to the golden image I set up?

source_records.text: Now, if you are ready, as soon as you hear the trumpet and every musical sound, to fall down and bow to the golden image I set up—but if not, know that unless you bow, you will immediately be thrown into the blazing furnace. What god will rescue you from my hands?”
source_records.display_text: Now, if you are ready, as soon as you hear the trumpet and every musical sound, to fall down and bow to the golden image I set up—but if not, know that unless you bow, you will immediately be thrown into the blazing furnace. What god will rescue you from my hands?”

source_records.text: Sedrach, Misach, and Abdenago answered King Nebuchadnezzar, “O king, we have no need to answer you concerning this command.
source_records.display_text: Sedrach, Misach, and Abdenago answered King Nebuchadnezzar, “O king, we have no need to answer you concerning this command.

source_records.text: For there is a God in the heavens, our one Lord, whom we fear, who is able to rescue us from the furnace of fire; and from your hands, O king, He will rescue us.
source_records.display_text: For there is a God in the heavens, our one Lord, whom we fear, who is able to rescue us from the furnace of fire; and from your hands, O king, He will rescue us.

source_records.text: Then it will be plain to you that we neither serve your idol nor bow to your golden image that you set up.”
source_records.display_text: Then it will be plain to you that we neither serve your idol nor bow to your golden image that you set up.”

source_records.display_text: Then Nebuchadnezzar was filled with fury, and the appearance of his face changed. He ordered the furnace heated seven times beyond what it needed to be heated.

source_records.text: He ordered the strongest men in his force to bind Sedrach, Misach, and Abdenago hand and foot and throw them into the blazing furnace.
source_records.display_text: He ordered the strongest men in his force to bind Sedrach, Misach, and Abdenago hand and foot and throw them into the blazing furnace.
